title: Content Creator - Tillsammans
description:
**OM OSS**  

  

Tillsammans är den nya tidens huvudbyrå där flera perspektiv och kompetenser inom kommunikation ryms på exakt lika villkor. Kunder vi jobbar med idag är AMF Fastigheter, LRF, Dustin, Nobis Hospitality Group, Bonava, Globen Shopping mfl. Vi sitter centralt på Götgatsbacken på Södermalm i Stockholm och delar kontor med våra systerbyråer, Folket och Kompis.


Är du sugen på en ny utmaning i ett härligt gäng? Vi söker nu en Content Creator med ett starkt intresse för rörligt innehåll som främst kommer att arbeta med videoproduktion och efterbearbetning.

**OM ROLLEN**  

  

I rollen som Content Creator på Tillsammans kommer du att ha en viktig roll där du förverkligar teamets idéer. Du kommer främst att ansvara för att producera, klippa och redigera rörligt innehåll till bland annat sociala medier, kampanjer, webb, digital annonsering och kundernas egna kanaler. Innehållet anpassas efter kanal, målgrupp och syfte – från kortformat och social-first content till större kampanjer.


Arbetet innebär att du jobbar hands-on med foto- och filmproduktion på location eller i studio. Detta kräver att du är självgående och trygg i att fatta snabba beslut.

**OM DIG**  

  

Som person är du social, kreativ och lösningsorienterad. Du har en positiv inställning i samarbetet med både kollegor och kunder samt en god känsla för kvalitet och service. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt, har ett gott ordningssinne och ett öga för detaljer. Samtidigt trivs du i en vardag där flera projekt och uppdrag pågår parallellt.


Du är van att ta fram och efterbearbeta rörligt material och behärskar även stillbild samt har du intresse att skapa content som berättar en historia. Du har erfarenhet av produktioner i mindre team och vet hur man maximerar innehållet från ett och samma produktionstillfälle. Du kan filma med såväl avancerad utrustning som mobilkamera och är trygg i att driva en produktion hela vägen från idé till leverans. Du är dessutom nyfiken på ny teknik och använder gärna AI som ett naturligt stöd i ditt kreativa arbete.

**KOMPETENSER OCH ERFARENHETER**

* Du har minst 3 års erfarenhet från frilansproduktioner inom rörligt eller en liknande roll på byrå, inhouse, mediehus eller produktionsbolag.
* Du är van att filma och fota professionellt både med systemkamera och mobiltelefon.
* Du är van att arbeta självständigt med att skapa rörligt material samt fotografering och efterbearbetning.
* Du kan anpassa material för olika kanaler och målgrupper.
* Du har en relevant utbildning inom området.
* Du har gedigen erfarenhet av Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro och After Effects, samt goda kunskaper i Figma.
* Du har erfarenhet av AI-verktyg för bildproduktion och bildbehandling.

**ANSÖKAN OCH KONTAKT**  

  

Anställningen är heltid med start omgående. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi ser gärna att du skickar med portfolio eller relevanta exempel på tidigare arbete i ansökan. För frågor angående tjänsten, kontakta Felicia Norberg, felicia.norberg@folketsthlm.se

  

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Digital Designer
description:
**Om rollen**
-------------


Som Digital Designer på Ingager skapar du visuella koncept och innehåll som är byggt för sociala plattformar. Du har ett starkt öga för design, rörlig grafik och digitalt berättande, men är minst lika nyfiken på hur AI och nya kreativa verktyg förändrar vårt sätt att arbeta.


Du trivs i en snabbfotad miljö där idéer snabbt blir innehåll, testar gärna nya arbetssätt och ser teknikutveckling som en möjlighet snarare än ett hot. För dig handlar design inte bara om estetik – utan om att skapa innehåll som engagerar, konverterar och fungerar i människors flöden.

**Ansvarsområden**
------------------

* Skapa visuellt innehåll för sociala medier i både organiska och betalda kanaler.
* Ta fram koncept, kampanjmaterial och kreativa idéer tillsammans med kreatörer, strateger och projektledare.
* Designa statiskt och rörligt material anpassat för olika plattformar och målgrupper.
* Säkerställa hög visuell kvalitet och ett konsekvent uttryck genom hela kundresan.
* Utforska, testa och implementera nya AI-verktyg och kreativa arbetsflöden som stärker både kvalitet och effektivitet.
* Bidra till att utveckla Ingagers kreativa processer genom att dela insikter, experiment och nya arbetssätt.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad kring designtrender, sociala plattformar och den snabba utvecklingen inom generativ AI.


Vi tror att du

* Har ett starkt visuellt öga och god känsla för form, färg, typografi och storytelling.
* Är van att skapa innehåll för sociala medier och förstår vad som fungerar på olika plattformar.
* Behärskar Adobe Creative Cloud och/eller Figma.
* Har erfarenhet av eller stort intresse för motion design och videoredigering.
* Är nyfiken, självgående och gillar att experimentera.
* Är bekväm med generativ AI och använder verktyg som en naturlig del av den kreativa processen – exempelvis för idéutveckling, bildgenerering, videoproduktion, research eller effektivisering.
* Ser AI som ett kreativt verktyg snarare än en ersättare och vill kontinuerligt utforska nya möjligheter.
* Kommunicerar väl och trivs med att arbeta tvärfunktionellt.

**Extra meriterande**
---------------------

* Erfarenhet av AI-verktyg som Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Kling, Veo, ChatGPT eller liknande.
* Kunskap inom 3D, animation eller interaktiv design.
* Erfarenhet av performance creative eller datadriven design.
* Intresse för automatisering, no-code och nya kreativa arbetsflöden.

**Hos Ingager får du**
----------------------

* Arbeta på en social first-byrå där kreativitet, teknik och kultur möts.
* Vara med och forma hur AI används i den kreativa processen – inte bara följa utvecklingen.
* Stora möjligheter att testa nya verktyg, experimentera och påverka våra arbetssätt.
* Samarbeta med ett kreativt team där idéer, lärande och utveckling står i fokus.
* Vara en del av en bransch som förändras snabbt – och ligga i framkant när den gör det.

### **Portfolio**


Vi vill gärna se exempel på arbeten som visar hur du tänker kreativt och löser visuella utmaningar. Portfolion behöver inte bestå av stora kampanjer – vi värdesätter även egna projekt, experiment och idéer.


Visa gärna:

* Design för sociala medier (statiskt och/eller rörligt).
* Kampanjkoncept eller content-serier.
* Motion design eller videoredigering.
* Exempel där du använt AI i den kreativa processen – oavsett om det handlar om idéutveckling, bild- eller videogenerering, prototyper eller nya arbetsflöden.

title: Product Support Associate I
description:
**Job Description**  

Are you keen to start your professional careers in a fast-growing and global IT company, where you will get the opportunity to apply your technical interest when helping our customers get the most out of our solutions?


Pagero has recently joined Thomson Reuters. Together, we are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection.


We are currently seeking a Product Support Associate I to join our office in Madrid. To thrive in this role, you adapt quickly to new tasks and are motivated by understanding the underlying factors to the problems you encounter. Furthermore, you have the will and ability to help customer and colleagues and always make an effort to deliver the best possible support.


**Key Responsibilities**

In this opportunity as a Product Support Associate you will:


* Help customers resolve questions related to our software, including investigating invoice issues, troubleshooting and looking into e-service cases using chat, phone and Case Management System as your most important tools
* Work on solving issues of varying difficulty, where you pilot the customer through Pagero’s services while teaching them the best ways to navigate and accomplish what they need
* Be part of a diverse team of supportive colleagues who work with cases of different levels of difficulty

**Required Qualifications**

You’re a fit for the role of a Product Support Associate if you have the following required qualifications:


* Completed upper secondary education. Post-secondary education in systems science, IT or technology is a merit
* A great interest and understanding of technology
* You speak and write fluent in **Swedish** and English
* Willingness to undertake shifts (occasional bank holidays)

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience from support, service or technology

#LI-LT1


**What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.
**About Us**

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.


We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.


As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.


We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here .


Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here .


More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, AI Natives
description:
MongoDB is looking for a highly accomplished, results-oriented individual with exceptional energy, intellectual curiosity, and entrepreneurial initiative to significantly expand our presence within the startup ecosystem. This AI Natives EAE role is critical for proactively identifying and cultivating strategic, net-new relationships with high-potential startup founders and executive decision-makers, while concurrently forging deep, impactful partnerships across the AI landscape, and expertly guiding complex sales cycles within an assigned territory.



This role is deeply connected to MongoDB's vision to become the Data Platform for AI, and you'll be at the forefront of that mission. You will be focused on winning the fastest-growing organizations in the world's most concentrated AI hub.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Amsterdam, Stockholm or Copenhagen for our hybrid working model.


### **What you will be doing**


* Serve as a pivotal leader within MongoDB GTM, working cross-functionally with Marketing and Product Leadership directly influencing and driving MongoDB's market penetration within the VC and startup ecosystem
* Architect and execute highly sophisticated, data-driven go-to-market strategies for the assigned AI Native territory, identifying key market segments and opportunities for exponential growth
* Drive executive-level engagement and influence within the startup community, with a particular focus on C-suite technical decision makers, visionary founders, and strategic investors
* Cultivate and maintain profound, long-term relationships with founders, VCs, key developers, and technical architects to (1) secure net-new logos within the startup ecosystem, (2) identify, establish, and mature strategic product and go-to-market partnerships, and (3) consistently exceed top-line revenue targets
* Develop and evangelize a comprehensive, expert-level understanding of MongoDB products, the competitive landscape, and partner technologies, positioning MongoDB as a thought leader

### **Who You Are**


* 8+ years of consistent quota-carrying field experience in highly competitive and rapidly evolving markets, with a proven track record of selling technically complex enterprise solutions at scale
* Exceptional intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development
* A profound history of identifying, building, and nurturing executive-level champions within your customer-base, and successfully navigating highly complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes
* Mastery in translating intricate technical concepts and nuanced technical challenges into compelling, quantifiable business value and strategic outcomes for customers
* Possess an inherent drive, intense competitiveness, and an insatiable desire to achieve extraordinary success and exceed expectations
* Must reside within the assigned territory and be willing to maintain a significant in-office presence (3+ days per week) to foster collaboration and team cohesion

### **Things we love**


* A passionate commitment to continuous learning and a strong aspiration to lead and define your career trajectory
* A proven ability to contribute significantly to building something truly special and scaling a high-growth business unit
* Deep familiarity with advanced software development concepts, emerging technologies, and a nuanced understanding of diverse developer and technical personas
* Extensive experience and a strong preference for selling to highly technical buyers and engineering leadership

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Job Posting
description:
**Location**
------------


Lund


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


On-site


**Department**
--------------


Technology and InnovationConsumer Applications


  
**About Us**
============


Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.


The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.


**Role Summary**
================


Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies (RVT) were founded on the idea to make the switch to electric sustainable transportation available to everyone and make a better way of travelling to new adventures – while of course making the world sustainable. In pursuit of this, Rivian bought the Swedish world class EV trip planning service ABetterRouteplanner.com (ABRP) in 2023 and quickly made it the tool for planning in-car and in app for Rivian vehicles.


The ABRP team continues to develop the product from Sweden, supporting both in-car systems such as Rivian as well as running our own direct consumer product ABetterRouteplanner.com. This direct consumer product is crucial for the development and further improvement of EV trip planning since we get tons of feedback and improvement proposals from our users, which we spend a lot of effort on picking up and using to improve our product.


This is where you would fit in – discussing with and helping our ABRP users in their needs to do their electric trips. The ABRP technical support team works on our Jira Helpdesk for direct user issues, but mostly on our public user feedback site abrp.featurebase.net where users report issues and request features, and the support team together with the development team responds, triages and fixes those issues.


In other words, you would be supporting our EV drivers via English text (no chat or phone), both in individual conversations but also in public forums.


**Responsibilities**
====================


* Respond to users’ reports on our public feedback forums, working with them to understand what the issues really are and ensure they feel that we listen to them.
* Triage the reported issues in our internal database tools such as Kibana to find out if our metrics and logs support what they say, to either resolve the case or help our development team find the bug.
* Prepare our weekly user feedback / bug meeting with the development team to prioritize the most urgent issues reported by users.
* Work with our data suppliers when issues are on their side (for example charger data or vehicle live data).
* Support ABRP users in resolving simple account issues such as Premium subscriptions, invoices, receipts, multiple accounts and password issues.

**Qualifications**
==================


* A technical interest and background, both to understand our ABRP product but also how electric vehicles work and what issues EV drivers may face.
* A strong interest in sustainability and making the shift from fossil fuels to something which works for our kids’ kids’ kids.
* Experience working in customer support and handling frustrated customers who often need some guidance to be able to explain what the issue they really have. The customers range from novices to EV experts.
* An interest and experience in working with a modern app development team (small but agile) in order to improve on the product.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------


We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.


Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.


In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. **Learn more about our global benefit programs****.**


External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (**https://rivianvw.tech/#careers**).


**Equal Opportunity**

title: Receptionist till Hotel Skeppsholmen
description:
Vill du vara en del av Hotel Skeppsholmen?
  
Hotel Skeppsholmen har 77 hotellrum, restaurang och bar samt möteslokaler och enastående festvåningar för stora och små kalas. Vi är även ett Svanenmärkt hotell, medlem i Design Hotels samt stolt samarbetspartner till vår granne Operakällaren Foundation/UNICEF och Project Playground.
  
Hos oss på Hotel Skeppsholmen är receptionen en levande avdelning där vi skapar en härlig och avslappnad atmosfär för våra gäster. Vi söker därför dig som kan leverera naturlig toppservice på ett ödmjukt och avspänt sätt då du kommer att vara den första och sista som gästen möter på hotellet.
  
Våra gäster är oftast väldigt pålästa och trendmedvetna därför behöver du vara en person som är intresserad av att vara uppdaterad på det senaste som händer i Stockholm, allt från nyöppnade restauranger och barer till butiker och museer.
  
Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer i synnerhet vara gästservice samt in-och utcheckning, samtidigt som det kan vara att ta emot våra konferensgäster eller att ge conciergeservice. Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av arbete i hotellreception och det är en fördel om du har använt PMS-systemet OPERA Cloud. Meriterande om du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom hotell-och restaurang.
  
  

Tjänsten innefattar heltid vilket innebär variation av dag-och kvällstid samt varannan helg med start så snart som möjligt.
  
  

Urval och intervjuer görs löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.
  
Skicka personligt brev och CV till jobb@hotelskeppsholmen.se

title: Analytics Engineer in-house
description:
Analytics Engineer
  
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
  
  

**The Role:**  

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
  
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
  
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
  
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
  
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**We are looking for someone with:**  

A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
  
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
  
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
  
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
  
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
  
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
  
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.
  
  

**Nice to have:**  

Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.
  
  

**What you will do:**  

You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
  
**Data Modeling & Quality:** Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
  
**Governance & Enablement:** Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
  
**Optimization & Agile Delivery:** Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.
  
  

**What we offer:**  

The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
  
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
  
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
  
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
  
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
  
Mental health & parental support offerings
  
30 days of paid vacation.
  
  

**Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:**  

5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
  
Private pension savings
  
  

**Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:**  

Deutschlandticket
  
Wellpass
  
  

About us
  
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.
  
  

Come work with us
  
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.
  
  

Apply today
  
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
  
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Business Analyst – SAP, Data & Customer Integration
description:
We are looking for an experienced Commercial Business Analyst for an assignment within a large organization operating in a regulated distribution environment.
  
The organization is embarking on a major transformation programme that is currently in the design phase. The programme includes an SAP migration as well as the development of a new cloud-based data foundation using Azure and Databricks. An important part of the future solution will be to establish structured and reliable data sharing with external customers.
  
This is a business-focused analyst role positioned between business, processes and data. Rather than focusing primarily on traditional requirements documentation, the role requires strong communication skills, process understanding and the ability to translate customer needs into clear and actionable data requirements.
  
The Role
  
You will work directly with external customers to understand their data needs and identify a common minimum data set that can serve as the basis for the engineering team's development.
  
You will collaborate closely with engineering, contribute to the ongoing SAP transformation and support the testing and validation of delivered solutions.
  
The relevant data domains include sales data, inventory levels, out-of-stock information, data related to controlled products, and invoice data used by financial systems. As incorrect data may have both commercial and compliance implications, a high level of accuracy, quality and traceability is essential.
  
Qualifications
  
  

Proven experience working directly with external customers and managing customer-facing dialogue.
  
  

Experience negotiating with external stakeholders and creating alignment between different requirements, priorities and expectations.
  
  

Experience with SAP and a good understanding of the business processes supported by the platform.
  
  

Experience in data modelling.
  
  

Understanding of distribution and logistics processes.
  
  

Ability to operate effectively between business processes and technology and translate requirements and needs in both directions.
  
  

Fluency in English.
  
  

Meritorious
  
  

Swedish language skills.
  
  

Experience from pharmaceutical distribution, life sciences or another regulated industry.
  
  

Previous involvement in SAP migrations or other large-scale transformation programmes.
  
  

Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, particularly Azure and/or Databricks.
  
  

Experience enabling or managing data sharing with external parties.
  
  

Personal Profile
  
We are looking for a specialist profile with strong depth of expertise rather than a broad generalist background. You have a commercial mindset and are comfortable leading business-oriented discussions, not only traditional requirements conversations.
  
You are confident in independently managing customer dialogues and moving discussions forward without extensive direction. At the same time, you have a structured approach and the ability to consolidate information from multiple parallel conversations into clear conclusions, priorities and actionable input for the delivery teams.
  
  

**Start Date & Application:**  

**Start Date:** 2026-09-07
  
**End Date:** 2027-09-01
  
**Application Deadline:** 2026-09-10
  
**Hybrid:** 2-3 days per week onsite
  
**Location:** Stockholm
  
Selections and interviews are ongoing!

Our primary focus lies in Finance, Administration, HR, Marketing, and IT, but we also have the broad expertise and flexibility required to deliver tailored recruitment solutions across all industries.
  
Although we are a relatively new player, we have already gained the trust of many of Sweden's largest companies and operate both nationally and internationally. With bases in Sweden and Spain, we offer a unique combination of local expertise and global reach. Our strong network and deep industry insights make us the obvious partner for companies looking to stay ahead in their recruitment efforts.

title: Platform Team Lead
description:
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
  
  

**The Role:**  

The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
  
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
  
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.
  
  

**With your help, we want to:**  

* Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
* Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
* Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.


Who you are
  
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
  
  

**You will thrive in this role if you bring:**  

* Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
* Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
* A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
* A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
* Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.


Qualifications
  
  

**We are looking for someone with:**  

* At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
* A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
* The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
* Fluency in English.
* Swedish or German skills are a plus.


**Nice to have:**  

* Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
* Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
* Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
* Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.


**What you will do:**  

You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
  
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
  
* Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
* Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
* Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
* Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
* Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.


**What we offer:**  

* The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
* Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
* Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
* A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
* Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
* Mental health & parental support offerings
* 30 days of paid vacation.


**Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:**  

* Deutschlandticket
* Wellpass


**Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:**  

* 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
* Private pension savings


About us
  
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.
  
  

Come work with us
  
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.
  
  

Apply today
  
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.

title: Account Executive — Nordics Public Sector
description:
**Location**
------------


Stockholm


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Business


  
**About Mistral**
-----------------


Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.


We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.


**Role summary**
----------------


As our **Account Executive for the Nordics Public Sector**, based in Sweden, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral AI's adoption across government, healthcare, education, and other public-sector institutions throughout Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.


You will own the full deal cycle end-to-end — from strategic prospecting and the first intro call through to closing, deployment, and expansion — working in close partnership with our dedicated implementation specialists, technical and legal teams.


This is a unique opportunity to bring sovereign, high-performance, and cost-efficient AI to the institutions that shape everyday life in the Nordics.


**What you will do**
--------------------


**Territory & lead development**


* Own the Nordics public-sector territory and build a multi-year, account-based plan covering central and local government, agencies, healthcare, and higher education across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
* Drive strategic outbound and qualified inbound outreach to public-sector buyers and the consultancies/integrators that influence their decisions.
* Convert inbound demand where upselling, framework agreements, or bespoke contracts can be achieved.

**Public-sector procurement & value validation**


* Guide customers through Proof of Concept (POC) phases, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation, including alignment with security, compliance, and sovereignty requirements typical of Nordic public tenders.
* Navigate procurement frameworks and translate successful POCs into long-term, revenue-generating framework or call-off agreements.
* Translate Mistral's value proposition into public-sector outcomes: efficiency, transparency, cost control, language coverage, data residency and ethical AI.

**Deal management & closing**


* Develop and execute strategic account plans to convert leads into valued, long-term public-sector customers.
* Act as the first point of contact for all external stakeholders — coordinating customer engineering, product, commercial, procurement and C-level stakeholders on both operational and executive levels.
* Lead customer negotiation end-to-end, in partnership with our legal and implementation specialist teams, including framework contracts, data-processing agreements and public-sector compliance requirements.

**Executive engagement**


* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level and Director-level executives across government agencies, regions/municipalities, hospitals, and universities — as well as heads of innovation, AI and digitalization.
* Understand their specific policy, regulatory, and operational challenges, and position Mistral's platform as an integral part of their strategic digitalization and AI initiatives.

**Technical aptitude**


* Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our products and articulate their value to both technical and non-technical public-sector audiences.
* Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure customer questions, concerns, and challenges are handled during pre-sales, deployment, and post-deployment — including reference architectures for sovereign deployments.
* Collaborate with our technical teams to address security, data-residency and integration inquiries

**Training & enablement**


* Empower internal teams with the knowledge, win-loss insights and market feedback gathered in customer conversations to drive product roadmap priorities and go-to-market alignment for the public sector.
* Contribute to building reusable playbooks, references and case studies that accelerate public-sector adoption across the Nordics and broader Europe.

**Who you are**
---------------


* **7–10 years of experience in enterprise sales or consultative selling**, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product to large organizations.
* **Public-sector track record:** demonstrable experience selling to or partnering with Nordic governments, agencies, regions/municipalities, healthcare, or higher-education institutions — including familiarity with public procurement processes and frameworks.
* **Nordics market knowledge:** strong existing network and cultural fluency across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
* Significant work experience within the AI ecosystem or a related data/infrastructure/cloud field.
* Experience at a successful, fast-growing startup — ideally in deep-tech.
* Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions confidently.
* Excellent academics: Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, Public Administration, or a related field.
* **Excellent English and fluent Swedish**; additional Nordic languages (Danish, Norwegian, Finnish) are a strong plus. Other European languages welcome.
* Outstanding negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills — with the credibility to engage both technical teams and senior public-sector decision-makers.
* Comfortable operating in a low-ego, fast-moving, and highly collaborative environment; a self-starter comfortable working remote-first with regular travel across the Nordics and to Mistral hubs.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.


For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.


**Privacy Policy**
------------------


Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Vi söker en Senior Account Manager som vill bli en del av oss på Telia Cygate i Norrköping .


Jag heter **Sara Olsson, Försäljningschef för Region Mellan** , och jag letar efter någon som vill växa tillsammans med oss. Vi är ett stöttande och framtidsinriktat sälj team som fokuserar på att skapa en säker och trygg IT miljö hos befintliga och nya kunder . Vi jobbar med komplex lösningsförsäljning inom våra kärnområden **IT Nätverk** **,** **IT** **säkerhet och Hybrid IT.**

**Vad du kommer att göra i rollen:**

Rollen som Senior A ccount M anager passar dig som har minst 5 års branschvana inom våra kärnområden . Vi söker dig som brinner för relations och värdeskapande försäljning . Som Senior A ccount Manager är du van att jobba med större kunder . Rollen är bred och det finns stora möjligheter till utveckling då vi arbetar med många kunder inom olika segment med olika miljöer.  



* Agera ansiktet utåt för att identifiera fler affärsmöjligheter hos våra befintliga kunder.
* Proaktivt arbeta med att hitta, driva och utveckla befintliga och nya kunder.
* Hjälpa våra kunder med deras framtida behov och säkerställa att vi bidrar till deras utveckling.
  

**För att lyckas i rollen:**

Som person är du en skicklig kommunikatör och är trygg i dialogen med människor på olika nivåer av en organisation. Du är genuint intresserad av IT och dess utveckling, och använder din omvärldskunskap för att lösa kundens utmaningar och behov.  



  

Du kommer särskilt till din rätt när du får omsätta visioner och önskemål från kund till genomförbara affärsförslag. Du får energi av att bygga relationer och skapa förtroende hos andra. Du samarbetar väl via kontinuerlig, enkel och tydlig kommunikation, och söker ständigt feedback för att förbättra ditt arbete.  

  



* Tidigare erfarenhet inom Nätverk, IT-säkerhet och/eller Hybrid Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av att leda och driva komplexa affärer.
* Relevant utbildning ses som meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling.
* Erfarenhet av proaktivt uppsökande, offerter och kundbearbetning.
* B-körkort.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
description:
**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What makes this role special?**


You will:

* Build and lead the FDE team in your location
* Join a small group of FDE leaders defining how the function operates and scales globally
* Stay deeply hands-on — personally building and shipping alongside your team
* Partner with customers building never-seen-before AI systems
* Set a high technical bar across architecture, engineering, and execution
* Turn patterns from real deployments into core product and platform improvements
* Influence our product direction, technical roadmap, and how FDE works at Lovable


If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself — this is that role.

**What we’re looking for**

* 12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering
* Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams
* A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown
* Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals across modern frontend and backend development
* Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
* Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end
* Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users
* Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior customer stakeholders
* High agency and comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments


Bonus if you’ve:

* Built a team or technical function from zero
* Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production
* Led zero-to-one product development
* Worked in a founding or early-stage startup environment
* Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI

**What you’ll do**


In one sentence: build the team that deploys intelligence into the real world — and deploy it alongside them.

* Recruit, develop, and lead an exceptional team of Forward Deployed Engineers
* Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems
* Personally design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team
* Own and guide projects from idea architecture shipping iteration
* Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering
* Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements
* Partner with other FDE leads to shape standards, playbooks, and how the function scales globally
* Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

**Our Tech Stack**


We choose tools that empower both humans and AI:

* Frontend: React, TypeScript
* Backend: Golang & Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers
* Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more
* Always evolving with what works best

**How we hire**


1. Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team


2. A technical leadership interview — how you build teams, set standards, and make technical decisions


3. Show us how you approach hard technical problems


4. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud


5. Conversations with the leaders you’d work most closely with, followed by a final discussion

**About your application**

* Please submit your application in English — it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally — if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal

title: Senior Business Analyst – SAP, Data & Customer Integration
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Commercial Business Analyst** for an assignment within a large organization operating in a regulated distribution environment.


The organization is embarking on a major transformation programme that is currently in the design phase. The programme includes an **SAP migration** as well as the development of a new **cloud-based data foundation using Azure and Databricks**. An important part of the future solution will be to establish structured and reliable data sharing with external customers.


This is a business-focused analyst role positioned between **business, processes and data**. Rather than focusing primarily on traditional requirements documentation, the role requires strong communication skills, process understanding and the ability to translate customer needs into clear and actionable data requirements.

**The Role**


You will work directly with external customers to understand their data needs and identify a common minimum data set that can serve as the basis for the engineering team's development.


You will collaborate closely with engineering, contribute to the ongoing SAP transformation and support the testing and validation of delivered solutions.


The relevant data domains include **sales data, inventory levels, out-of-stock information, data related to controlled products, and invoice data used by financial systems**. As incorrect data may have both commercial and compliance implications, a high level of accuracy, quality and traceability is essential.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience working directly with external customers and managing customer-facing dialogue.
* Experience negotiating with external stakeholders and creating alignment between different requirements, priorities and expectations.
* Experience with SAP and a good understanding of the business processes supported by the platform.
* Experience in data modelling.
* Understanding of distribution and logistics processes.
* Ability to operate effectively between business processes and technology and translate requirements and needs in both directions.
* Fluency in English.

**Meritorious**

* Swedish language skills.
* Experience from pharmaceutical distribution, life sciences or another regulated industry.
* Previous involvement in SAP migrations or other large-scale transformation programmes.
* Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, particularly Azure and/or Databricks.
* Experience enabling or managing data sharing with external parties.

**Personal Profile**


We are looking for a **specialist profile with strong depth of expertise rather than a broad generalist background**. You have a commercial mindset and are comfortable leading business-oriented discussions, not only traditional requirements conversations.


You are confident in independently managing customer dialogues and moving discussions forward without extensive direction. At the same time, you have a structured approach and the ability to consolidate information from multiple parallel conversations into clear conclusions, priorities and actionable input for the delivery teams.

**Start Date & Application:**


Start Date: 2026-09-07


End Date: 2027-09-01


Application Deadline: 2026-09-10


Hybrid: 2-3 days per week onsite


Location: Stockholm


Selections and interviews are ongoing!

Our primary focus lies in Finance, Administration, HR, Marketing, and IT, but we also have the broad expertise and flexibility required to deliver tailored recruitment solutions across all industries.


Although we are a relatively new player, we have already gained the trust of many of Sweden's largest companies and operate both nationally and internationally. With bases in Sweden and Spain, we offer a unique combination of local expertise and global reach. Our strong network and deep industry insights make us the obvious partner for companies looking to stay ahead in their recruitment efforts.

title: AI Tech Lead
description:
**AI Tech Lead**
================

*Viva är en av Nordens främsta byråer inom digital marknadsföring, där vi kombinerar mänsklig expertis med AI och smarta verktyg för att skapa långsiktig, datadriven tillväxt för våra kunder. Vi strävar efter extremt nöjda kunder och stolta medarbetare – och vi bygger framgång genom både de resultat vi levererar och den kultur vi skapar. Idag är vi drygt 80 medarbetare med kontor i Uppsala, Malmö och Kalmar.*


Nu tar vi nästa steg i vår AI-satsning och söker en AI Tech Lead.


Det här är inte en traditionell chefsroll. Vi söker inte någon som vill lämna utvecklingen bakom sig. Vi söker en person som fortfarande älskar att bygga AI-lösningar, men som också vill leda andra utvecklare och vara med och forma framtidens AI-erbjudande.


Hos oss blir du den tekniska ledaren för vårt AI-team. Du kommer själv utveckla avancerade AI-agenter, sätta den tekniska riktningen för vår plattform och hjälpa våra kunder att förstå hur AI kan skapa verklig affärsnytta.


Du trivs lika bra med att utveckla avancerade AI-lösningar som att diskutera teknik, affär och strategi med kunder och kollegor.

**Om rollen**


Som Ai Tech Lead ansvarar du för både människor, teknik och lösningar.


Du leder vårt AI-utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du själv är en aktiv utvecklare. Du arbetar med komplexa AI-projekt, utvecklar nya agentlösningar och säkerställer att Viva fortsätter ligga i absolut framkant inom AI.


Samtidigt blir du en viktig del av vårt kommersiella AI-erbjudande. Du deltar i kundmöten, workshops och säljpresentationer där du hjälper företag att förstå hur AI kan effektivisera verksamheter, skapa nya möjligheter och lösa affärsutmaningar.


Du kommer arbeta nära vår ledning, våra utvecklare och våra kundteam för att omsätta den senaste AI-tekniken till produkter och lösningar som gör verklig skillnad.

**Ditt uppdrag**


Hos oss kommer du att:

*Leda AI-teamet*

* Leda, coacha och utveckla våra AI-utvecklare.
* Skapa ett team där innovation, kvalitet och kunskapsdelning står i fokus.
* Prioritera utveckling och säkerställa att vi bygger rätt lösningar.

*Bygga AI-lösningar*

* Själv utveckla avancerade AI-agenter och AI-drivna applikationer.
* Designa agentarkitektur och integrationslösningar.
* Utveckla Viva Marketing OS och andra AI-produkter.
* Bygga lösningar med moderna LLM-plattformar, agentramverk och molntjänster. Säkerställa att våra lösningar är skalbara, säkra och robusta.

*Utveckla vårt AI-erbjudande*

* Vara teknisk expert i kundmöten, workshops och säljpresentationer.
* Vara med och utveckla Vivas AI-erbjudande och nya tjänster.
* Följa utvecklingen inom AI och omsätta ny teknik till kommersiella möjligheter.

**Vem är du?**


Du är en person som både älskar teknik och drivs av att lösa verkliga affärsproblem.


Du har sannolikt arbetat flera år med AI-utveckling och känner dig hemma inom generativ AI, agentbaserade system och moderna molnplattformar. Samtidigt trivs du i dialogen med kunder och gillar att hjälpa andra utvecklare att växa.


Du är en naturlig ledare – inte för att du säger åt andra vad de ska göra, utan för att du själv visar vägen.

**Vi tror att du har:**

* Erfarenhet av att leda utvecklare.
* Förmåga att kommunicera komplex teknik på ett enkelt och affärsnära sätt.
* Mångårig erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-agenter och agentbaserade lösningar.
* Djup kunskap inom generativ AI och moderna LLM-plattformar, exempelvis Claude eller OpenAI.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av agentramverk som LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i exempelvis Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL) och Google Cloud Platform.
* God förståelse för API:er, integrationer och serverless-arkitektur.
* Kunskap inom säkerhet, GDPR och AI-governance.


Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat inom Martech, SaaS eller konsultverksamhet.

**Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?**


Vi bygger inte AI för att följa en trend.


Vi bygger AI som förändrar hur marknadsföring fungerar.


Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett av Nordens mest offensiva AI-erbjudanden. Du får stort mandat, korta beslutsvägar och möjligheten att påverka både tekniken, produkterna och affären.

**Hos oss får du:**

* En nyckelroll i Vivas fortsatta AI-satsning.
* Möjlighet att leda ett växande och kompetent AI-utvecklingsteam.
* Arbeta med den senaste tekniken inom AI.
* Frihet att testa nya idéer och omsätta dem till verklighet.
* Ett värderingsdrivet bolag med höga ambitioner och korta beslutsvägar.
* En innovativ arbetsmiljö där vi arbetar med några av Nordens mest spännande varumärken.
* Balans mellan jobb och fritid.

#### **Om tjänsten och ansökan**


Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och bli en del av Viva? Skicka in din ansökan idag och låt oss skapa framtiden tillsammans! Tillträde enligt ök.

title: Praktikant inom kreativ och visuell kommunikation till Barnfonden
description:
**Vill du skapa innehåll som får barn att lära, upptäcka och känna att de kan vara med och göra skillnad? Är du kreativ och gillar illustration, grafisk form, animation, video eller annat visuellt skapande? Då kan det här vara praktikplatsen för dig!**


Som praktikant inom kreativ och visuell kommunikation blir du en del av Barnfondens kommunikations- och insamlingsteam. Du får inblick i hur det är att arbeta med kommunikation och kampanjer i en barnrättsorganisation och möjlighet att utveckla dina kreativa kunskaper i skarpa projekt. Under praktiken får du också möjlighet att lära dig mer om kommunikation, målgruppsanpassning, barnrätt och internationellt utvecklingsarbete.


Fokus kommer framför allt ligga på att tillsammans med kommunikations- och kampanjansvarig bygga upp innehållet till vår nya satsning Barnfondens Barnklubb – en digital mötesplats där barn får aktiviteter som ger hopp och handlingskraft i en tid då allt fler barn känner oro för klimatet och omvärlden.


Vi är en liten organisation där det finns stora möjligheter att komma med egna idéer och påverka det du arbetar med. Här får du arbeta hands-on med ett riktigt projekt. Du får vara med från idé till färdigt innehåll och se hur det du skapar faktiskt kommer att användas av barn och familjer.


Det kan till exempel handla om att:

* illustrera och formge kreativt material för barn, till exempel pysselpaket kopplat till högtider, lov, temadagar och aktuella händelser
* producera material för sociala medier och digitala kanaler
* ta fram idéer och koncept för nya aktiviteter
* ta fram affischer, guider och annat pedagogiskt material

**Vi tror att du**

* studerar grafisk design, visuell kommunikation, illustration, animation, media, digital design eller en liknande utbildning
* har erfarenhet av något eller några kreativa verktyg, exempelvis Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva eller liknande
* tycker om att skapa visuellt innehåll och har ett öga för färg, form och uttryck
* är nyfiken på illustration, grafisk form, rörligt innehåll och/eller digital kommunikation
* tycker att det är roligt att skapa innehåll för barn
* är kreativ, initiativtagande och gillar att testa nya idéer
* kan arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra

**Omfattning och praktikperiod**


Praktiken är på heltid och omfattar en hel termin under vårterminen 2027, eller enligt överenskommelse. Praktiken genomförs helst som en del av en utbildning. Ingen ersättning utgår från Barnfonden.

**Ansökan**


Skicka din ansökan med CV och gärna portfolio eller exempel på tidigare kreativt arbete senast den 30 oktober 2026. Skriv några rader om vad just du är bra på, tycker är roligt och vill utveckla under praktiken.


Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och kan komma att tillsätta praktikplatsen innan sista ansökningsdatum.

title: Receptionist Scandic Grand Central, deltid 40%
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 30 september 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

\*\*Scandic Grand Central är ett nav för kultur i Stockholm!\*\* Med konstutställningar, konserter och en egen teater är det alltid något som händer innanför de anrika väggarna. Vi som arbetar på hotellet trivs i den fartfyllda och kreativa miljön och har en gemensam vilja att erbjuda våra gäster det lilla extra. En mix av det historiska och det moderna beläget mitt i Stockholms hjärta. För dig som uppskattar en internationell och inspirerande social scen som andas musik och kultur. Om du kunde sätta ett stetoskop på Stockholms kropp skulle hjärtljuden slå högst där Scandic Grand Central är. Så vart slår dina hjärtljud? Älskar du musik, konst och kreativa miljöer lika mycket som oss? Då är du den vi söker!


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Grand Central.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.

description:

* Stockholm

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

\*\*Scandic Grand Central är ett nav för kultur i Stockholm!\*\* Med konstutställningar, konserter och en egen teater är det alltid något som händer innanför de anrika väggarna. Vi som arbetar på hotellet trivs i den fartfyllda och kreativa miljön och har en gemensam vilja att erbjuda våra gäster det lilla extra. En mix av det historiska och det moderna beläget mitt i Stockholms hjärta. För dig som uppskattar en internationell och inspirerande social scen som andas musik och kultur. Om du kunde sätta ett stetoskop på Stockholms kropp skulle hjärtljuden slå högst där Scandic Grand Central är. Så vart slår dina hjärtljud? Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!

Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).
