title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
#### **The opportunity**


Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. As a digital-first, cloud-driven organisation, cybersecurity is a critical enabler of our business, products, and services.


We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen and evolve our enterprise security capabilities. This role focuses on designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving security controls that protect our workforce, data, identities, devices, networks, and digital services.


This is not a traditional operations-focused security role. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building, automating, and improving security capabilities at scale while working closely with technology teams across the organisation.

#### **Let us describe the challenge we offer**


As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening Polestar’s enterprise security posture and advancing our Zero Trust journey. You will help build scalable security capabilities that protect users, devices, identities, data, and enterprise services in a modern cloud-first environment.


This role is located at: **Polestar Headquarters, Gothenburg, Sweden.**


We believe in empowerment and support flexible working hours and a hybrid way of working.

#### **What you’ll do**


You will work across security engineering, automation, and operational resilience, partnering with teams throughout the organisation to embed security by design and continuously improve enterprise security capabilities.


This includes:

* Implementing and continuously improving security capabilities across endpoint, identity, network, collaboration, and data protection domains.
* Supporting the deployment, optimisation, and governance of enterprise security platforms and controls.
* Building and maintaining security automations that reduce manual effort and improve operational effectiveness.
* Improving detection, response, and resilience capabilities across the enterprise environment.
* Partnering with infrastructure, workplace, cloud, networking, and engineering teams to embed security by design.
* Driving the implementation of Zero Trust principles, including strong identity controls, least privilege, continuous verification, and network segmentation.
* Supporting the secure adoption of AI technologies and helping establish technical guardrails that reduce risk while enabling innovation.
* Improving data protection and information security capabilities to ensure sensitive information is protected throughout its lifecycle.
* Contributing to security architecture decisions and helping define future security capabilities and standards.
* Evaluating new technologies and continuously improving security tooling, integrations, and processes.
* Serving as a Tier 3 security engineering escalation point for complex incidents and high-priority security events.
* Participating in a shared on-call rotation supporting our Security Operations Centre (SOC) for approximately five weeks annually.

#### **Who you are**


You are a hands-on cybersecurity engineer who enjoys solving technical security challenges and building scalable security solutions.


You combine strong security engineering expertise with a pragmatic mindset and understand how to balance security, usability, and business objectives. You are comfortable working across engineering, operations, and automation, and can translate security requirements into effective technical controls.


Most importantly, you view security tooling and processes as systems that can be engineered, automated, and continuously improved.


You bring:

* At least 5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong technical understanding of enterprise security architectures and controls.
* Experience implementing security solutions across endpoint, identity, network, and data protection domains.
* Experience building automations, integrations, or custom tooling to improve security operations and engineering outcomes.
* Strong scripting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in cloud-first and modern enterprise environments.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A passion for continuous improvement and a builder’s mindset.


You have experience with:

* Microsoft security technologies.
* Data protection, data security, privacy, and DLP.
* Endpoint security and device management.
* Network security and Zero Trust architectures.
* Email and collaboration security.
* Security automation, orchestration, and scripting.
* Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and secure configuration management.


In addition, you may also have experience with:

* Identity, access, and privilege management.
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and cryptographic controls.
* AI security, governance, and risk management.


You are motivated by creating meaningful impact and helping strengthen security capabilities across identities, endpoints, networks, and data. You enjoy increasing automation, improving resilience, expanding Zero Trust adoption, and enabling the secure and responsible use of emerging technologies, including AI.

#### **People at Polestar**


We know that change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate-neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative. Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

#### **Is this you?**


If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. As part of our recruitment process, you may be asked to complete assessments and participate in background checks relevant to the position. We apply a continuous selection process, and the job posting will remain open until the position is filled.


Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We are looking for data engineers to design, build, and maintain the end-to-end declarative data platform that powers ingestion, transformation, and consumption across Lovable. You are obsessed about empowering teams to ensure data systems are scalable, reliable, safe and easy to use.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What we are looking for:**
* Strong experience with cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks or similar).
* Deep understanding of data ingestion frameworks, orchestration(Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi or similar).
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis or similar).
* Proficiency in SQL, and distributed systems. Knowledge in Go is a plus.
* Strong communication and documentation skills. Be able to align technical details with strategic goals.


**What you will do:**
* Develop and maintain core data infrastructure (data lake, warehouse, orchestration, observability, governance).
* Partner with other platform and domain teams to design data pipelines and implement declarative configuration for ingestion and transformation.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, and security standards are embedded across all workflows.
* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to define modeling conventions and enforce schema governance.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for data systems and assist with cost optimization and performance tuning.
* Define data platform best practices and support self-service enablement.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
* Complete the general programming exercise.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
* Tell us about your most impressive project.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Enterprise Account Executive, AI Natives
description:
MongoDB is looking for a highly accomplished, results-oriented individual with exceptional energy, intellectual curiosity, and entrepreneurial initiative to significantly expand our presence within the startup ecosystem. This AI Natives EAE role is critical for proactively identifying and cultivating strategic, net-new relationships with high-potential startup founders and executive decision-makers, while concurrently forging deep, impactful partnerships across the AI landscape, and expertly guiding complex sales cycles within an assigned territory.
   

  

 This role is deeply connected to MongoDB’s vision to become the Data Platform for AI, and you’ll be at the forefront of that mission. You will be focused on winning the fastest-growing organizations in the world’s most concentrated AI hub.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Amsterdam, Stockholm or Copenhagen for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

* Serve as a pivotal leader within MongoDB GTM, working cross-functionally with Marketing and Product Leadership directly influencing and driving MongoDB’s market penetration within the VC and startup ecosystem
* Architect and execute highly sophisticated, data-driven go-to-market strategies for the assigned AI Native territory, identifying key market segments and opportunities for exponential growth
* Drive executive-level engagement and influence within the startup community, with a particular focus on C-suite technical decision makers, visionary founders, and strategic investors
* Cultivate and maintain profound, long-term relationships with founders, VCs, key developers, and technical architects to (1) secure net-new logos within the startup ecosystem, (2) identify, establish, and mature strategic product and go-to-market partnerships, and (3) consistently exceed top-line revenue targets
* Develop and evangelize a comprehensive, expert-level understanding of MongoDB products, the competitive landscape, and partner technologies, positioning MongoDB as a thought leader


 Who You Are
   

  

* 8+ years of consistent quota-carrying field experience in highly competitive and rapidly evolving markets, with a proven track record of selling technically complex enterprise solutions at scale
* Exceptional intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development
* A profound history of identifying, building, and nurturing executive-level champions within your customer-base, and successfully navigating highly complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes
* Mastery in translating intricate technical concepts and nuanced technical challenges into compelling, quantifiable business value and strategic outcomes for customers
* Possess an inherent drive, intense competitiveness, and an insatiable desire to achieve extraordinary success and exceed expectations
* Must reside within the assigned territory and be willing to maintain a significant in-office presence (3+ days per week) to foster collaboration and team cohesion


 Things we love
   

  

* A passionate commitment to continuous learning and a strong aspiration to lead and define your career trajectory
* A proven ability to contribute significantly to building something truly special and scaling a high-growth business unit
* Deep familiarity with advanced software development concepts, emerging technologies, and a nuanced understanding of diverse developer and technical personas
* Extensive experience and a strong preference for selling to highly technical buyers and engineering leadership


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa verkligt värde hos våra kunder med hjälp av Analytics och AI? Vi på Atea i Stockholm söker nu en erfaren och driven Data Engineer där du blir en del av vårt satsningsområde där målsättningen är att bli ledande. Vill du bidra med din expertis, ständigt utvecklas och forma framtidens digitala samhälle? Då har vi utmaningen för dig!
   

  

**Din roll**
 Två områden som Atea satsar på är Analytics och AI där vår målsättning är att bli ledande. Med din kompetens inom datahantering i moderna dataplattformar blir du en naturlig brygga för att väva samman våra satsningar inom Analytics och AI.
   

  

 Som konsult på Atea är du en drivkraft bakom din egen, Ateas och våra kunders framgång. Konsultrollen erbjuder spännande och utmanande uppdrag, på egen hand eller i team med andra kollegor. Du får möjlighet att möta nya människor och kontexter där du ansvarar för att driva innovativa projekt framåt, bidra med din expertis och identifierar nya möjligheter där både du och Atea kan skapa värde för våra kunder.
   

  

 Du kommer att vara en del av vårt affärsområde Information Management som omfattar strategi, arkitektur, information & data analytics (AI, BI, RPA och IoT), verksamhetsutveckling, förändringsledning, it-styrning, projektledning samt informations- och cybersäkerhet.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Kravdialog med kund
* Förstå och se möjligheter till analys av data
* Utveckling av datalager/dataplattformar och dataflöden
* Stötta kunder med rådgivning


 Joanna Nordlund, Konsultchef på Atea, kommer att vara din närmste chef i rollen. Du kommer ingå ett team på åtta drivna och ansvarstagande kollegor som jobbar tätt tillsammans och alltid ställer upp för varandra. Du kommer även jobba tätt med andra team inom området på Atea. Inom teamet är det högt i tak och prestigelöst och vi har en bred kunskap som består av både juniora och seniora personer.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi tror på dig och dina personliga egenskaper, som är viktiga för att lyckas och trivas hos oss. Vi ser att du tar ansvar för dina uppgifter, strukturerar och driver ditt arbete självständigt. Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa synsätt och tillvägagångsätt till ändrade omständigheter. Du sätter höga mål för dig själv och arbetar aktivt för att uppnå dem, samt söker aktivt utmaningar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Du har ett affärsmässigt fokus och förstår innebörden att leverera hög klass på service mot våra kunder. Med god erfarenhet är du självgående inom området och du brinner för att utvecklas inom områdena Analytics och AI.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen som Data Engineer ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Relevant akademisk utbildning inom datautveckling, systemutveckling, datavetenskap eller närliggande område.
* Flera års erfarenhet av utveckling och förvaltning av datalager, dataplattformar och data pipelines.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och implementera arkitektur för Analytics- och dataplattformslösningar.
* God förståelse för moderna dataplattformar och dataekosystem.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av programmering, exempelvis i Python.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla, produktionssätta och förvalta datadrivna lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av datamodellering och informationsstrukturering.
* Förmåga att uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av etablering och utveckling i Microsoft Fabric.
* Erfarenhet av Databricks, Spark, Snowflake eller SQL Server.
* Erfarenhet av Amazon S3, Airflow eller liknande verktyg för datahantering och orkestrering.

**Om Atea**

 På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.

title: Account Executive — Nordics Public Sector
description:
**About Mistral**
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
   

  

 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
   

  

****Role summary****
 As our
 **Account Executive for the Nordics Public Sector** 
 , based in Sweden, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral AI's adoption across government, healthcare, education, and other public-sector institutions throughout Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
   

  

 You will own the full deal cycle end-to-end — from strategic prospecting and the first intro call through to closing, deployment, and expansion — working in close partnership with our dedicated implementation specialists, technical and legal teams.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to bring sovereign, high-performance, and cost-efficient AI to the institutions that shape everyday life in the Nordics.
   

  

****What you will do****
**Territory & lead development**
* Own the Nordics public-sector territory and build a multi-year, account-based plan covering central and local government, agencies, healthcare, and higher education across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
* Drive strategic outbound and qualified inbound outreach to public-sector buyers and the consultancies/integrators that influence their decisions.
* Convert inbound demand where upselling, framework agreements, or bespoke contracts can be achieved.


**Public-sector procurement & value validation**
* Guide customers through Proof of Concept (POC) phases, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation, including alignment with security, compliance, and sovereignty requirements typical of Nordic public tenders.
* Navigate procurement frameworks and translate successful POCs into long-term, revenue-generating framework or call-off agreements.
* Translate Mistral's value proposition into public-sector outcomes: efficiency, transparency, cost control, language coverage, data residency and ethical AI.


**Deal management & closing**
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to convert leads into valued, long-term public-sector customers.
* Act as the first point of contact for all external stakeholders — coordinating customer engineering, product, commercial, procurement and C-level stakeholders on both operational and executive levels.
* Lead customer negotiation end-to-end, in partnership with our legal and implementation specialist teams, including framework contracts, data-processing agreements and public-sector compliance requirements.


**Executive engagement**
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level and Director-level executives across government agencies, regions/municipalities, hospitals, and universities — as well as heads of innovation, AI and digitalization.
* Understand their specific policy, regulatory, and operational challenges, and position Mistral's platform as an integral part of their strategic digitalization and AI initiatives.


**Technical aptitude**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our products and articulate their value to both technical and non-technical public-sector audiences.
* Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure customer questions, concerns, and challenges are handled during pre-sales, deployment, and post-deployment — including reference architectures for sovereign deployments.
* Collaborate with our technical teams to address security, data-residency and integration inquiries


**Training & enablement**
* Empower internal teams with the knowledge, win-loss insights and market feedback gathered in customer conversations to drive product roadmap priorities and go-to-market alignment for the public sector.
* Contribute to building reusable playbooks, references and case studies that accelerate public-sector adoption across the Nordics and broader Europe.


**Who You Are**
* 7–10 years of experience in enterprise sales or consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product to large organizations.
* Public-sector track record: demonstrable experience selling to or partnering with Nordic governments, agencies, regions/municipalities, healthcare, or higher-education institutions — including familiarity with public procurement processes and frameworks.
* Nordics market knowledge: strong existing network and cultural fluency across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
* Significant work experience within the AI ecosystem or a related data/infrastructure/cloud field.
* Experience at a successful, fast-growing startup — ideally in deep-tech.
* Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions confidently.
* Excellent academics: Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, Public Administration, or a related field.
* Excellent English and fluent Swedish; additional Nordic languages (Danish, Norwegian, Finnish) are a strong plus. Other European languages welcome.
* Outstanding negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills — with the credibility to engage both technical teams and senior public-sector decision-makers.
* Comfortable operating in a low-ego, fast-moving, and highly collaborative environment; a self-starter comfortable working remote-first with regular travel across the Nordics and to Mistral hubs.


****What we offer****
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
   

  

 For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
   

  

****Privacy Policy****
 Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Build the future of open finance!** 




 We believe people deserve real transparency around their finances. As a leader in open finance, Insurely gives consumers easy access to data from banks and insurers, helping them make better financial decisions. We make complex financial data simple and useful and that’s where you come in.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for an experienced senior engineer to join our new markets product mission. This is the team building the bridge between Insurely and the new markets in Europe we are expanding to.
 



  





 You’ll work across our stack and take significant ownership of the technical problems you work on. We expect you to be comfortable working independently, making sound technical decisions and navigating problems where the answer isn’t always obvious.
 



  





 You don’t need to be fullstack today. You might be stronger in backend or frontend right now. What matters is that you have a strong engineering foundation, are curious to broaden your scope, and enjoy solving problems end to end.
 



  





 Our core is Node.js + TypeScript on the backend and React + TypeScript on the frontend. Most days you’ll be working in those environments. We run on AWS and manage infrastructure with Terraform. We also work with modern Java and Spring Boot, so if you have experience with these, it’s a plus.
 



  





 AI is a core part of how we build at Insurely. We actively integrate the latest models and tools both in our internal workflows and directly in our products. That means you'll work hands-on with cutting-edge AI as a natural part of your day-to-day, not as a side project.
 



  





 What matters most is your curiosity and ability to pick the right tool for the job. We think it's important to care about writing clean, maintainable code and designing systems that scale.
 



 If you like turning messy real-world problems into simple, usable solutions, we're sure you'll enjoy it here!
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design, build, and deploy features that make financial data more transparent and accessible
* Integrate and experiment with the latest AI models and tools to improve both our products and how we work
* Contribute to architecture and tech decisions. We value pragmatic engineering over fancy solutions
* Help shape how we work as we grow our team and platform



  





 AI is a core part of how we build at Insurely. We actively integrate the latest models and tools both in our internal workflows and directly in our products. That means you'll work hands-on with cutting-edge AI as a natural part of your day-to-day, not as a side project. What matters most is your curiosity and ability to pick the right tool for the job. We think it's important to care about writing clean, maintainable code and designing systems that scale.
 



  





**Why join us?** 




 Work on problems that matter! We’re building infrastructure that changes how people understand their finances. Here you'll stay at the forefront of AI. We don't just follow trends, we actively shape how AI fits into our product and engineering culture.
 



 Join a small, skilled team that values autonomy, curiosity, and simplicity and influence our tech direction and culture as we scale.
 



  





 We’re based at Kungsgatan 9, Stockholm. We can’t wait to meet you!
 



  





*Insurely is part of the Top 100 Rising European Startups selected by VivaTech 2026.*

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en komplex och modern IT-miljö där digitalisering, molntjänster och plattformsutveckling står högt på agendan.
   

  

 Uppdraget passar dig som trivs med att skapa struktur, driva framdrift och koordinera många olika intressenter samtidigt som du bidrar till verksamhetens långsiktiga utveckling.
   

  

 Om uppdraget

 Heltid

 2026-09-14 till 2027-06-30

title: Chief Expert / Information Architect in LC&I
description:
**Job ID: 5661**
 Data is the foundation of our business and confidence in data is key for serving our customers in the right way in Large Corporates and Institutions (LC&I). Are you passionate about information architecture and would you like to build deep insight into the LC&I data landscape? We are now looking for an Information Architect who will play a pivotal part in driving strategic deliveries in our Data & AI transformation and ensure reliable and high quality data both for business processes and regulatory purposes.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Welcome to LC&I Data Management. We collaborate closely with the LC&I business and help implementing clever data management practises, often in a complex data landscape. Data is the backbone of everything we do, and the team adds value by ensuring the data meet the business needs and regulatory requirements across the LC&I business value chain. If you are a strategic thinker with passion for information architecture, and have a proven track record of driving complex initiatives through influence and collaboration, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Leading cross-organizational collaboration: Independently collaborate with diverse stakeholders including Service Area/Domain Business Leads, Technology Leads, Architects, Data SMEs etc. to develop comprehensive metadata and information models to enable business objectives
* Driving results through influencing: Drive relevant Data Product deliveries without formal authority by effectively influencing stakeholders and building consensus across the organization
* Stakeholder engagement: Interact with internal stakeholders in LC&I, and coordinate alignment across other Business Areas and Group Functions including Group Technology, GDM and Group Architecture
* AI-powered automation: Develop and implement AI agents to automate manual-heavy processes, enhancing efficiency and reducing operational overhead
* Data Domain expertise: Leverage deep technical and conceptual understanding of LC&I data domains to design robust information architectures that support business objectives
* Data Standards development: Develop data standards and build business information models for Markets data subject areas while ensuring cross data domain alignment and regulatory compliance
* Change leadership: Support business stakeholders in adopting new tools, technologies and methodologies while managing key initiatives under tight timelines and pressure


**Who You Are**
**This is the right role for you if you possess:**
* Data Product Expertise: Strong understanding of data product development, data reference architecture, and data architecture principles
* Information Architecture Competence: Proven ability to independently collaborate across organizations with different stakeholders to develop comprehensive information models
* Influence and Leadership: Demonstrated track record of driving results through effective stakeholder influence, particularly with senior leadership
* AI and Automation Expertise: Strong competence in developing AI agents and automated solutions to streamline manual-heavy processes and resolve bottlenecks in information architecture workflows
* Data Domain Knowledge: Strong technical and conceptual understanding of key financial data domains, including (but not limited to) market risk & valuation data, trade data, instrument data, and custody & safekeeping data
* Risk & regulatory expertise: Deep understanding of data-related banking regulations (e.g., BCBS 239, CRR/CRD, GDPR, ECB supervisory expectations), with the ability to identify data-related risk exposures, navigate complex regulatory requirements, and translate them into practical controls to ensure robust and sustainable compliance
* Communication and Change Management: Exceptional communication skills with proven change management capabilities and a development-oriented mindset
* Performance Under Pressure: Ability to work effectively under pressure while managing tight timelines and competing priorities


**Your background and skills include:**
* Strong background in data management and governance, with expertise in leveraging advanced analytics and automation
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to lead by example and foster collaborative environments
* Fluent in English (professional level)
* Master’s degree preferred in Finance, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Relevant qualifications in data management, information modelling, or AI/ML are considered an advantage


**What We Offer**
**People** 
 come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

**A culture** 
 that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

**Hybrid working model –** 
 we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion** 
 are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 10/09/2026.
   

  

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships.** 
 We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.** 
 We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

**We lead change.** 
 We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea.** 
 We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Sweden:** 
 For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknologi, AI-drivna ansats, start-up-kultur och fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, ger vi dig förutsättningarna att nå din fulla potential och skapa värde för våra kunder. Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.

 Vill du kombinera kundansvar, konsultledning och operativ leverans i en roll med stort affärs- och verksamhetsfokus? * Ansvara för onboarding och offboarding av konsulter samt säkerställa en strukturerad introduktion och avslut av uppdrag.

* Erfarenhet av leverantörs- och konsultstyrning inom större ramavtal.
* Erfarenhet av att skapa och utveckla professionella relationer med kunder, konsulter och andra intressenter.
* Erfarenhet av att planera, prioritera och driva flera aktiviteter parallellt i komplexa organisationer.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.


*Meriterande är erfarenhet av VMS-plattformar såsom Fieldglass, Magnit eller motsvarande system. Vi förstår att få kandidater uppfyller varje önskemål fullt ut. Om du känner igen dig i huvuddelen av profilen ser vi gärna att du söker rollen.*
**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**
* En nyckelroll med verkligt inflytande där du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka leveransen till en av våra mest strategiska kunder inom offentlig sektor.
* Ett engagerat och stöttande team som präglas av nära samarbete, kunskapsdelning och långsiktiga relationer, både med kollegor, konsulter och kund.
* Goda möjligheter att växa över tid genom en inkluderande kultur som värdesätter olika perspektiv och satsar på kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, ledarskap och hållbara karriärer.


**Ansökan**
*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov* 
*.*
**Om Sogeti**
 Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat.
   

  

***Right here. Right now.***
 | www.sogeti.se

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Younium 🌍** 




 Younium is the subscription management and billing platform for B2B SaaS companies with subscription models. Our customers run their quote-to-cash process on Younium, from CPQ through billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting.
 



 We are in full growth mode. You'll thrive in a high-energy, creative, and transparent environment fueled by collaboration. With hubs in Amsterdam, Kraków, Stockholm, Malmö, and Philadelphia, plus remote contributors, we're building a truly global team. 🌍
 



 The Customer Success team owns retention and expansion across the Nordics, Benelux, UK, Germany, France, and a growing US base. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth and commercial strategy within that team.
 



  





 Want to make a real difference for subscription businesses around the world? Come join us!
 



  





**The role:** 




 Subscription management is never just a system implementation. It reshapes how a company sells, bills, recognises revenue, and reports. It touches Sales, Finance, CS, and Operations, and it only succeeds when those processes are designed together. You know this because you have done it.
 



 In this role you help customers define their target end state, design the path to get there, and prove the value along the way. You lead discovery that uncovers where the friction sits in a customer's quote-to-cash process, translate that into a solution design across CRM, ERP, and Younium, and run demos that show the outcome, not the feature list. You give our CSMs the technical and strategic depth to hold commercial conversations with RevOps leaders and CFOs. Your time goes to expansion, retention, and enablement, not project delivery.
 



  





**What you'll be doing:** 



* Lead strategic discovery: map the customer's quote-to-cash process, identify manual work, revenue leakage, and system mismatches, and quantify the cost of staying where they are
* Define the customer's target end state and the solution design to reach it, across CRM, Younium, and ERP
* Guide customers toward measurable outcomes: integrated quote-to-cash, accurate financial KPIs, one source of truth, controlled revenue leakage, automated billing, scalable pricing
* Run demos and workshops for expansion opportunities, with CPQ as a core motion, tailored to the personas in the room, from Sales Ops to CFO
* Act as strategic and technical counterpart for CSMs on renewals and strategic accounts, including architecture reviews, RFP responses, and security questionnaires
* Feed structured customer and market input back to Product and Engineering



  





**Who are you?** 



* Hands-on Younium experience, ideally from implementing Younium in finance, sales, or CS organisations as a consultant, implementation specialist, or platform admin
* Deep understanding of what a subscription management implementation involves: redesigning the order-to-invoice flow, aligning sales and finance on data ownership, structuring products and pricing, setting up revenue recognition, and managing the change that comes with it
* Knowledge of the full process chain: quoting, order management, provisioning, invoicing, dunning, renewals, revenue recognition, financial reporting
* Experience guiding customers from current state to a defined end state, holding them accountable to milestones along the way
* 6-8+ years in solutions engineering, presales, or implementation consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally in billing, subscription management, CPQ, or ERP
* Comfort in both business and technical conversations: process design with a CFO in the morning, API questions with a RevOps team in the afternoon
* Excellent written communication for solution documentation, RFP responses, and security questionnaires
* Fluent in professional English, with either German, Dutch, or a Nordic language as a second language
* Comfort working across European time zones with occasional travel

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.
   

  

 As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.
   

  

 Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are proud of our ability to combine technical expertise with sound business sense. This translates to solutions that are not only effective in addressing current challenges but also sustainable long term. Our team is composed of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that enables us to manage data end to end – from optimizing data pipelines to developing user-friendly models for analysis.
   

  

 Our technology stack includes BigQuery (SQL), Looker, dbt™, and Google Cloud Platform, with opportunities to evaluate and introduce new technologies as we scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Analytics Engineer, you'll work with developing data capabilities that power decisions across our global organization. You'll have significant technical and organizational impact, driving both immediate solutions and long-term strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Examples Of Responsibilities**
* Develop data transformation steps and build a strong data modeling foundation for enabling self-service analytics across the company.
* Build and maintain trusting, working relationships with business partners across domains and discover high-impact opportunities to enable self-service analytics in our semantic layer.
* Strategically plan and deliver meaningful projects to increase data literacy at Storytel.
* Lead the resolution of critical data issues, establishing monitoring systems and best practices to prevent future problems and improve data reliability.
* Collaborate with data practitioners to understand their needs and requirements, breaking down complicated technical concepts to fit the audience.
* Drive adoption of technical best practices across the data team, mentoring others and bringing in industry innovations that improve how we work.


**We believe that you have**
* Experience with creating and maintaining semantic layers.
* Experience in working with data (BI/Analytics/Data Engineering) specializing within Analytics Engineering.
* Deep expertise in SQL and data modeling and extensive experience with modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt™, Looker, BigQuery, or equivalent tools).
* The ability to consistently deliver performant, accurate, and scalable solutions.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving team-wide technical improvements.
* Proven ability to lead complex data projects, solve problems independently, and proactively improve products.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to various audiences.
* The ability to thrive in a feedback culture and constantly strive to improve your own skills and knowledge.


**Bonus If You Experience**
* Working with Python.
* With data governance and access management.
* With different data modeling schemas.
* Working with international teams and global data operations.


 Join a world of stories
   

  

 At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.
   

  

 Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.
   

  

 Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

title: Fordonsintresserad Software Download Engineer
description:
Nu söker vi dig som vill kombinera tekniskt djup med händerna i verkstaden. Till vår kund inom fordonsindustrin i Göteborgsregionen söker vi en Support Engineer inom Software Download (SWDL) som blir en del av teamet som verifierar nästa generations elsystem på en komplett lastbil – en av de mest komplexa produkterna som tillverkas. Kanske är du nyexaminerad ingenjör med ett brinnande fordonsintresse, eller så har du några års erfarenhet från ingenjörsyrket och vill nu fördjupa dig i mjukvarunedladdning, felsökning och verifiering av testfordon.


I rollen får du resa och möta både återförsäljare och slutkunder, du får jobba nära riktiga testlastbilar och riggar, och du blir en del av ett team med bred kunskap om hela fordonets el- och mjukvarusystem – inte bara en kodrad på en skärm.


Ser du fördelarna med att få variation och erfarenhet från olika kunder och branscher men att utvecklas med en och samma arbetsgivare? Som medarbetare på ESSIQ får du det bästa av två världar. ESSIQ är arbetsgivaren som anstränger sig lite extra för att du ska må bra. Vad är medarbetarfokus för dig? På ESSIQ handlar det om att sätta medarbetaren i centrum. Genom ett lyhört ledarskap och en öppen företagskultur vill vi ge varje medarbetare möjligheten att forma sin karriär och sin vardag.

**ROLLBESKRIVNING**


Som Support Engineer är du ett viktigt stöd i verifieringsprocessen av nya produkter. Det betyder att du får en unik inblick i hur man verifierar ett av de mest komplexa fordon som tillverkas, och du får kunskap om nästa generations elsystem långt innan det når marknaden. Din vardag består av programnedladdning/mjukvaruladdning (SWDL), funktionskontroll och felsökning (fault tracing) på testfordon och verifieringsriggar, samt parametersättning av styrenheter (ECU:er).

* Verifieringsstöd på testfordon och riggar – du är med och säkerställer att konstruktionen faktiskt fungerar i verkligheten
* Programnedladdning (SWDL), pamarametersättning av styrenheter och funktionskontroll på testfordon, inklusive provkörning efter mjukvaruuppdatering
* Felsökning och root cause-analys i labb, rigg och lastbilsmiljö
* Variation mellan kontor och verkstad, med mycket praktiskt hands-on-arbete
* Resor till återförsäljare och slutkunder – bred kontaktyta både internt och externt

**KVALIFIKATIONER**


Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet.


Grundläggande kvalifikationer

* Högskoleingenjör eller motsvarande utbildning&erfarenhet
* Är lösningsorienterad, självgående och har ett stort tekniskt intresse
* Trivs med praktiskt arbete och tycker om att lösa komplexa problem
* Är bra på att kommunicera, både på svenska och engelska
* Innehar B-körkort
* C-körkort krävs för rollen. Har du inte C-kort redan är det ingen katastrof – det viktigaste är att du är motiverad att ta det under uppdragets första kvartal. Vi stöttar och bekostar utbildningen.


Meriterande

* Innehar redan C-körkort
* God förståelse för fordons elektriska arkitektur, gärna med kunskap om kompletta lastbilar
* Erfarenhet från produktutveckling
* Kunskap i verktyg som CANalyser, Kola, Protus, PROTOM, Configurator, SE-Tool och ClearQuest


Personlighet och engagemang

* Du är ansvarstagande – du kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind.
* Du är social och kommunikativ – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bekväm med att prata om dig själv, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare.
* Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – du tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd.

**OM TJÄNSTEN**

* Anställningsform: Heltid, med provanställning och goda möjligheter till tillsvidareanställning.
* Tillträde: Snarast – vi planerar för start under september/oktober för att säkerställa en smidig överlämning inom teamet.
* Sista ansökningsdag: 25 september 2026 (urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan).
* Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringar. Behöver du ta C-körkort stöttar och bekostar vi utbildningen under uppdragets första kvartal.
* Placering: ESSIQ Väst – Göteborg med omnejd.

**OM ESSIQ OCH VÅRT ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG**


ESSIQ är en arbetsplats med stor laganda och där allt börjar med dig, din livssituation och dina intressen. Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att forma din egen karriär, en modern lönepolicy och flexibla lösningar. Med ca 100 fantastiska medarbetare, främst ingenjörer, jobbar vi med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling där du antingen utgår från vårt kontor eller är på plats hos våra kunder. Vi har mer än 80 spännande kunder inom olika branscher, allt från små innovationsbolag till stora utvecklingsföretag. Vi strävar efter att matcha dina intressen och ambitioner med rätt uppdrag. Hos oss kommer kunden i andra hand – bra, eller hur?


På ESSIQ värnar vi om jämställdhet och strävar efter att ha 50% kvinnliga medarbetare på samtliga positioner i företaget. Vi stödjer även organisationer som främjar och lockar unga kvinnor att studera tekniska ämnen på högskolan för att på sikt öka antalet kvinnor i teknikbranschen. Dessutom har vi ett medvetet miljöarbete för att minska vår miljöbelastning och bidra till ett mer hållbart samhälle. Vi samarbetar långsiktigt med kunder som möjliggör att vi kan arbeta med hållbara ingenjörsuppdrag som har positiva miljöeffekter.

**ANSÖKAN**


Vi behöver en smidig överlämning inom teamet under hösten, så vänta inte med din ansökan – sök tjänsten senast 25 september 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

title: Team Lead Legal Engineering, Law Firms, Scandinavia & Baltics
description:
**About Us**
------------


Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  

  

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  

  

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$100M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.  

  

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  

  

Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.


If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**About the role**
------------------


Legal Engineering sits at the intersection of legal practice, product, enterprise change and commercial execution.


As Team Lead for Law Firms across Scandinavia and the Baltics, you will report to the Head of Legal Engineering, North EMEA and lead a team of Legal Engineers from Stockholm. This is a manager role, but it requires the craft credibility and scope of someone already operating at senior Legal Engineering level. You will stay close enough to the work to coach from first-hand evidence, set weekly priorities, raise delivery quality, manage capacity and escalations, and personally lead selected strategic engagements where senior judgment matters.


The regional opportunity has two distinct parts. Scandinavian firms are sophisticated adopters. The next phase is deeper practice-group adoption, clearer proof of value, competitive renewals and expansion. The Baltic market is earlier and more concentrated, with a realistic opportunity to help the leading firms establish how AI becomes part of everyday legal work.


This is a player-coach manager role for someone who can combine first-line leadership with Lead Legal Engineer or Director-level judgment. Your success will be measured by the quality and independence of the team, the outcomes customers achieve, and the methods that continue to work without you in every room.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead the day-to-day operating rhythm for the law-firm Legal Engineering team, including priorities, 1:1s, coaching, capacity, quality review and escalation.
* Translate regional commercial priorities into clear weekly execution across accounts. Keep every material pilot, rollout, renewal and expansion tied to a named owner, next step, risk signal, governance forum and measurable outcome.
* Lead selected high-value law-firm engagements from discovery to go-live, especially where the customer problem is ambiguous, senior-stakeholder heavy or commercially important. Turn legal problems into credible workflows, agree success measures and help firms move from isolated use cases to repeatable adoption across practice groups.
* Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, practice leaders, innovation and knowledge teams, IT leaders and day-to-day champions. Create the conditions for bad news and blockers to surface early.
* Partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement on conversion, usage, renewal and expansion. Bring legal judgment into commercial decisions, shape the service model for strategic accounts and make the value of Legal Engineering visible.
* Coach Legal Engineers on demos, workshops, programme plans, stakeholder communications and difficult client moments. Step in when required, then return ownership rather than keeping it.
* Build a strong sponsor-and-champion model inside customer firms so that implementation has both day-to-day energy and senior decision-making support.
* Turn recurring client patterns into reusable templates, checklists, recordings, narratives and playbooks that improve delivery across the region and raise the standard for how the team serves sophisticated law firms.
* Represent the voice of Scandinavian and Baltic law firms inside Legora. Log product gaps with evidence, translate field patterns into actionable requirements, propose practical fixes and follow through with Product.
* Hire and ramp strong Legal Engineers. Apply a consistent bar in interviews, give new joiners clear expectations and shorten the path to independent client work.
* Protect quality and sustainable pace while the team grows. Challenge poorly scoped work, surface structural capacity issues early and prevent the team from becoming dependent on heroics.

**What good looks like**
------------------------


This is a senior player-coach manager role requiring full autonomy across high-value, multi-stakeholder and often multi-product engagements. The impact should show up in faster adoption, better time to value, stronger customer outcomes across more than one account, and a team that produces more consistent work because of how it is led.

* **Product knowledge and application.** You own priority use cases from discovery to go-live with measurable success targets. You connect product choices to the firm's legal and commercial goals, define what great looks like for large programmes, produce assets others can reuse, and turn product gaps into evidence-based recommendations.
* **Communication.** You lead meetings, workshops and demos with senior law-firm stakeholders. You explain how Legora creates measurable value in business terms, handle complex objections cleanly and adapt your register across partners, associates, innovation leads and technical teams.
* **Project and programme management.** You lead detailed planning for complex enterprise work, using standard methods where they help and varying the playbook where the context demands it. You keep owners, dependencies, risks, governance and outcomes visible, then adjust quickly when reality changes.
* **Stakeholder management.** You build trusted senior relationships, identify concerns before they become blockers, influence priorities and navigate conflict between stakeholder groups. You can operate credibly with managing partners, practice leaders and executive sponsors while coaching less experienced Legal Engineers to own relationships themselves.
* **Thought leadership.** You lead substantive discussions on how AI will change law-firm work and economics. You synthesise field evidence into credible client narratives, contribute original ideas to the roadmap, represent Legora's point of view in senior forums and help the wider team develop a sharper point of view.

**How you lead as a first-line manager**
----------------------------------------


Strong first-line leadership in this role looks like this:

* **Hiring judgment and partnership.** You are active in sourcing, interviews, case calibration, closing and onboarding. You partner tightly with Talent and keep the quality bar stable when growth pressure rises.
* **Talent development and accountability.** Your team knows where they stand. You run regular 1:1s, give early written feedback and create clear development plans. You invest in coaching and act when the evidence shows that the slope is not changing.
* **Ownership, delegation and operating rhythm.** You own team outcomes without taking back every task. Priorities, decision rights, leading indicators and dependencies are clear. Team members hold real areas of ownership, and the team can run day to day without you present.
* **Team-first leadership and culture.** You give the team credit and take accountability for misses. You create stretch opportunities, show up when pressure rises and build enough trust that risks and bad news travel early.
* **Performance bar and decisive judgment.** You set a clear standard, identify underperformance early and distinguish coachable gaps from persistent misses. Decisions are evidence-based, timely, fair and humane.


The practical test is simple: the team should produce better work, stronger people and more repeatable customer outcomes because of how you lead, rather than because you personally carried every important engagement.

**What success looks like after 12 months**
-------------------------------------------

* The team has a clear weekly rhythm, reliable account ownership and fewer late escalations.
* Every team member knows what strong performance looks like, where they stand and what they are developing toward.
* Strategic law-firm pilots and rollouts have explicit value measures, senior sponsorship and credible paths into renewal or expansion.
* Customer learning travels across markets through reusable playbooks rather than remaining with one person or account.
* The team has visible informal owners and successors, with less dependence on the Team Lead for routine decisions.
* Go-to-Market, Engagement and Product treat the team as a high-trust partner with sound legal, product and commercial judgment.

**What you bring**
------------------


You may come from a leading law firm, legal innovation or knowledge, legal operations, professional services, legal technology, or a combination of those worlds. The common thread is evidence that you have improved how sophisticated lawyers work and helped other people raise their standard.


You will thrive in this role if you:

* Bring substantial experience of sophisticated law-firm work and the judgment to influence senior legal stakeholders. A Scandinavian legal qualification is preferred but not required; equivalent credibility can come from legal innovation, knowledge, legal operations, professional services or legal technology.
* Bring substantial senior experience, often around 8 to 14 years of relevant work. Scope, autonomy, repeated impact and evidence of operating at Lead Legal Engineer or Director-level scope matter more than tenure alone.
* Understand law-firm economics, partner incentives, practice-group dynamics and the tension between innovation, quality, risk and billable work.
* May have managed people directly, which is an advantage, but it is not a prerequisite. This can be a growth move into formal management if you can show repeated evidence of first-line leadership through coaching, feedback, delegation, hiring or performance judgment.
* Can personally lead a difficult client workshop, demo or programme while developing others to do the same.
* Are deeply curious about generative AI and product. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be able to test workflows, challenge assumptions and explain limits accurately.
* Connect Legal Engineering work to commercial outcomes, including conversion, adoption, usage, renewal and expansion, and know how to make that value visible to GTM, Engagement and senior customer stakeholders.
* Bring structure to ambiguity without creating process for its own sake. Your systems make decisions faster, quality more consistent and team execution less dependent on individual heroics.
* Communicate fluently in English. Any Scandinavian language is preferred but not required.
* Are based in Stockholm and able to work from the office five days per week. You are also comfortable travelling across Scandinavia and the Baltics for strategic customers, team leadership and market work.

**A few more things**
---------------------


You will inherit real customer proof, a fast-growing Stockholm team and a region with material commercial momentum. You will also inherit the useful mess that comes with scale: uneven adoption, competitive renewals, local-market differences, new joiners who need to ramp quickly and a management layer still being built.


The right person will enjoy that combination. They will be credible with a senior partner, practical with the team doing the work and disciplined enough to turn strong individual execution into a system.

 **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**


At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Position:** Mechanical Design Engineer


**Department:** Mechanical Design


**Reports to:** Head of Mechanical Design


**About the Role**



Envirotainer was founded in 1985 and today operates more than 10,000 active temperature-controlled containers worldwide. Every day, our products are used to transport millions of doses of life-saving pharmaceuticals. With more than 40 years of experience and operations in over 100 countries, we are an important part of the global pharmaceutical supply chain.



Envirotainer has approximately 450 employees globally, of whom around 150 work at our office and production facility in Rosersberg, Sweden.



As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will join our Mechanical Design team of eight engineers based in Sweden and Germany. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across R&D, as well as with Production, Maintenance, Sourcing, and other functions. You will report to the Head of Mechanical Design.


**A Few Words from Your Future Manager**


*"Hi! My name is Karl, and I lead our Mechanical Design team, the group responsible for mechanical design and mechanical engineering topics related to our products. I have been with Envirotainer since 2011 in various R&D roles.*


*People sometimes ask me what has kept me at Envirotainer for so many years, and my answer is simple: it never gets boring. We are on a continuous journey of development, and there is always something new to tackle.*


*We have an exciting mix of innovation, new product development, and improvement of products already operating around the world. This means we constantly face new technical challenges and have opportunities to grow, both as individuals and as a team."*


**What We Offer**


* **A Job That Makes a Difference**


Our temperature-controlled containers transport life-saving pharmaceuticals around the world. The work you do helps ensure that medicines reach patients in the right condition, wherever they are needed.


* **An Exciting Environment for Engineers**


Within R&D, we work on everything from solving technical issues and improving existing products to driving innovation and developing entirely new solutions. This creates a dynamic environment with plenty of technical challenges and opportunities to make an impact.


* **Collaboration Across Disciplines**


Our products bring together mechanical, electronics, and software engineers, technical writers, project managers, and other specialists around shared challenges. Together, we take solutions all the way from concept to products in operation.


* **Opportunities to Contribute and Grow**


You will have ownership of your work and the opportunity to contribute with your experience while becoming part of a team with broad technical expertise. We share knowledge, challenge each other's ideas, and grow together as our company and products evolve.


**Responsibilities**



As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will work with mechanical engineering topics throughout much of the product lifecycle. One day you may be investigating a technical issue in a product operating somewhere in our global fleet; the next day you could be contributing to a new design solution or development project.



The most important design characteristics vary depending on the challenge. Sometimes the focus is on creating a robust and cost-effective solution that is easy to manufacture. In other cases, priorities may include functionality, weight, repairability, or flexibility. Since our products are transported by air, finding the right balance between low weight and required performance is an important part of the design process.



In this role, you will:


* Develop and improve mechanical solutions for existing and future products.
* Create concepts, CAD models, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Investigate technical issues, perform analyses, and identify root causes.
* Plan and execute tests to demonstrate compliance with requirements.
* Participate in design reviews and contribute to the development of our engineering processes and ways of working.
* Collaborate with other engineering disciplines and business functions to ensure solutions work effectively in real-world applications.


This role is well suited to someone who enjoys variety and wants to combine design engineering with analysis, testing, and technical problem-solving.


**Who We Are Looking For**



We believe you are a curious and motivated engineer who enjoys understanding how things work and how they can be improved. You take a structured approach to your work, enjoy taking ownership, and thrive when solving technical challenges together with others.



You do not need to know everything from day one, but you have established a solid technical foundation and are eager to continue developing your skills while contributing your own experience and ideas.



You have:


* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* Several years of experience in mechanical design engineering or similar product development work.
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, as both languages are used in the role.


We will place great emphasis on your personal qualities, technical curiosity, and motivation to join Envirotainer and contribute to our continued success.


**Location**  

This role is located in our R&D facility in Rosersberg, north of Stockholm. Limited travels can be expected.


**Recruitment process**



In this recruitment, we cooperate with Academic Work so please apply via this link. https://www.academicwork.se/lediga-jobb/j/mekanikkonstruktor-till-envirotainer/5MWFMM


  
**Contact person**
------------------


Karl Brandberg


Hof Design and Mechanics


+46765277376


karl.brandberg@envirotainer.com

title: Founding Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




 At Open Ring (www.o-ring.tech), we’re behind the world’s first open-source smart ring platform, built for researchers, startups, and developers. We’re building a community-driven ecosystem for wearable tech innovation. As we scale, we’re eager to welcome exceptional talent ready to contribute to a global movement.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re building an open smart-ring platform that brings together wearable hardware, embedded firmware, mobile applications, web products, APIs, and developer tools. We’re looking for a strong
 **Full-Stack Software Engineer** 
 to own and ship software across the product stack, from our WordPress/CMS website and web applications to backend services, mobile integrations, internal tools, and developer-facing platform features.
 



  





 In this role, you’ll build and maintain customer-facing web experiences, dashboards, admin tools, backend APIs, data workflows, and mobile-connected product features. You’ll work with sensor data from wearable hardware, support BLE/mobile integration, and help create the software layer that enables data synchronization, visualization, exports, SDK access, and integrations for developers and researchers.
 



  





 It’s a broad, high-ownership engineering role for someone who can move confidently across frontend, backend, mobile, CMS, APIs, and platform development, and who is comfortable shipping practical, reliable software in a fast-moving startup environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own full-stack feature development across web applications, backend services, mobile-connected product features, internal tools, and developer-facing platform products.
* Maintain and extend our WordPress/CMS website, including custom templates, plugin integrations, landing pages, analytics, performance, technical SEO, security, and backend integrations.
* Build customer-facing dashboards, admin tools, developer portals, onboarding flows, and data-management interfaces.
* Extend iOS and Android app functionality for wearable-device workflows, including BLE discovery, pairing, GATT interactions, background sync, offline data capture, and reconnection handling.
* Design and maintain backend services, REST APIs, authentication, database schemas, data models, background jobs, and third-party integrations.
* Build sensor-data workflows for ingestion, synchronization, storage, visualization, logging, exports, analytics, and data-quality checks.
* Collaborate with the embedded systems engineer on BLE protocol design, GATT services/characteristics, payload formats, device-state handling, and firmware/mobile integration testing.
* Build developer-facing tools, including SDKs, API documentation, sample applications, integration guides, and data-export utilities.
* Improve reliability, performance, security, observability, testing, deployment, and maintainability across the software stack.
* Work closely with the founding team, users, researchers, and partners to prototype quickly, test with real hardware, and ship production-ready features.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong full-stack web development experience.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills and experience with React, Next.js, Vue, or similar frontend frameworks.
* Backend/API experience using Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, or similar, including REST APIs and database-backed applications.
* Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase, Supabase, MongoDB, or similar.
* Comfortable with WordPress/CMS development, including theme/plugin customization, PHP, performance, SEO, security, and maintenance.
* Mobile development experience is a strong plus, especially React Native, Swift/iOS, Kotlin/Android, or native integrations.
* Bonus: experience with IoT, BLE/GATT, wearable devices, device connectivity, or sensor-data workflows.
* Able to own features end-to-end, communicate clearly, and ship quickly in a lean startup environment.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work directly with a small founding team and own meaningful parts of the product across web, mobile, hardware integrations, and platform.
* Build a next-generation wearable platform that opens sensor data to developers, researchers, and partners through APIs, SDKs, dashboards, and data tools.
* Move quickly from prototype to pilot to production with real hardware and early users.
* Shape the architecture across web applications, backend services, mobile apps, data workflows, and device integrations.
* Equity-based compensation with long-term upside.



  





 Are you ready to contribute to the next generation of smart wearables - apply now!
 **Please note that as the company is still in its early stages, this role is currently only equity-compensated.** 




  





 We would love to hear from you!
